pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Cool-season:$() sow as soon as the ground thaws. Sprouts after 50 °C·d above 4 °C.$(li)Ripens after $(thing)650 °C·d$(). Best near 18 °C; stops above 28 °C.$(li)$(thing)Frost$() kills it below -3 °C (-2 °C in flower).

$(li)$(thing)Soil pH$() 6-7 (tolerates 5.5-7.8). Roots 0.4 m. Some tolerance of wet soil.$(li)$(thing)Feeds on$() N 90, P 15, K 120 kg/ha per crop.$(li)$(thing)Yield$() when well grown: about 312 cwt/ac (35 t/ha).$(li)$(thing)Harvest:$() Lettuce and Lettuce Seeds.
